tools.name: improvement_next
tools.title: Next improvement
tools.description: Use when you take on improvement work: take the next improvement card, the open card that waited longest. It claims the card for a limited time and returns it with the `claim_id` and the authority statement. A refusal comes back as `status` (claim_held, cap_reached, none_open, too_many_cards, machine_key_unavailable or noninteractive) with a one-line `meaning`. Optional `session` is the session's UUID.
